notes: Independent Preclean track for acceptance window 2026-10-16..2026-10-20 Asia/Shanghai. Excluded 122 publication_ids from /workspace/epi-known-pubs.txt. Did not read or copy EPI-track outputs under /workspace/epi-acceptance-raw/2026-10-20-epi-track. Google Patents XHR date-bounded queries (EN+CN; CPC H01L21/0204x, C23C16/4405/0245; SiCoNi/Selectra; HF vapor/AHF; remote plasma; NF3 chamber clean; integrated preclean) returned total_num_results=0 for 2026-10-15..2026-10-21 and for most 2026-10-01..2026-10-21 preclean+epi combinations. Espacenet web search and CNIPA-oriented web queries likewise yielded no in-window in-scope publications. USPTO OG week42 (expected ~2026-10-20 grant issue) was not available (403/404) at search time 2026-10-20 evening Asia/Shanghai; week41 (2026-10-13) inspected. Near-window but OUTSIDE this acceptance window (not listed as candidates): US12757665B2 grant 2026-10-06 ASM IP Holding — anhydrous HF + water vapor semiconductor preclean apparatus/method (USPTO OG week40 https://patentsgazette.uspto.gov/week40/OG/html/1551-1/US12757665-20261006.html); not in known-pubs list but event_date before ~2026-10-16. US12760412B2 grant 2026-10-13 Lam Research — nozzle for remote plasma cleaning of process chambers (https://patentsgazette.uspto.gov/week41/OG/html/1551-2/US12760412-20261013.html); generic chamber RPC hardware, not clearly tied to pre-epi/integrated preclean flow → scope-out / borderline. Pending already tracked — no NEW disposition-changing official evidence in this pass: CN122564748A (pub 2026-08-14, status Pending on Google Patents; epi cluster with pre-clean chamber + chamber clean chemistries including HF/NH3 or NF3/NH3) and WO2026084898A1 (pub 2026-04-23, status Pending; Applied Materials auto-doping barrier for epi Si, not a new pre-epi dry clean event). Out-of-scope noise: WO2026208761 wafer wet bevel/oxide-film wet clean (~2026-10-08); RU SiO2 nanopowder CMP purification news 2026-10-16 (CNews); packaging-substrate Ar-plasma preclean chamber-clean CN articles dated 2026-08/09. Limitations: Google Patents index lag for same-week USPTO grants is real (US12757665/US12760412 often fail direct number lookup); Espacenet and USPTO gazette week42 blocked or unpublished; CNIPA gazette day books not machine-scraped end-to-end. Zero candidates here does NOT claim zero misses globally—only that this independent query set found no verified in-window in-scope NEW publication/grant to add.
